acceptance_predicates.description: The contract requires an explicit setup --output file and contains no implicit user-home or XDG configuration authority.
One configuration can represent agents, providers, credential references, models, workloads, monitors, measures, and bounded live/sweep execution choices.
Schemas, examples, and tests retain only credential references or digests, never secret values.
The configuration-to-plan digest and identity contract permits deterministic mismatch detection at validate, run, and sweep time.

definition_of_done: A versioned contract and tests establish the sole configuration authority for all subsequent migration work.

inputs.description: Completed AR-1759 project/tool configuration work, reused only where compatible with explicit-file ownership.

outputs.description: Shared schema and command contract for setup-created configuration and config-bound plans.

gates.description: Schema and focused CLI contract tests prove explicit path, redaction, and plan-binding semantics.
